scope: Multi-core differential protocol feasibility; v2 envelope; v1 compatibility; QEMU 11.1.0 multi-vCPU plugin callback capability; two-core minimal sequence or fallback; checkpoint minimal extension.

d0_verdict.recommended_path: reference-model + litmus fallback for first version

qemu_probe.method: read-only source audit; no shared QEMU execution, no socket/checkpoint writes
findings: All vCPU plugin callbacks pass vcpu_index; qemu_info_t exposes smp_vcpus/max_vcpus.
qemu_plugin_register_vcpu_insn_exec_cb is before-instruction (PLUGIN_GEN_FROM_INSN); no public after-instruction retirement callback.
Memory callbacks report successful accesses after the access; faulting accesses are absent.
Single-thread RR uses one shared host thread for all vCPUs; a plugin blocking in a callback blocks all vCPUs and cannot be used as a per-vCPU token scheduler.
MTTCG thread=multi gives per-vCPU host threads, enabling in-principle token scheduling, but is incompatible with -icount.
Current lcvex_difftest.c is hardcoded to single-vCPU global pending/store state and needs per-core state for v2.

v2_design.v1_compatibility_rule: v1 header/message/trace/checkpoint formats unchanged; v2 uses new payload envelope, does not reinterpret v1 fields.
event_boundaries: PRE is execution-before and must never be called after-retirement.
COMMIT is derived from next same-core before callback or async/idle boundary, not an official after-retirement event.
ASYNC covers IRQ/FIQ and WFI wake synthesis.
v2_design.two_core_sequence: Provided as canonical v2 sequence; not claimed as already executed under stock QEMU.

checkpoint_min_extension: shared L2/directory state and dirty owner
per-core protocol pending and vcpu_seq watermark
separate v2 manifest to preserve legacy manifest readability

tests.summary: No whitespace errors in staged/unstaged changes.
Static probe of QEMU 11.1.0 plugin API and TCG scheduler; no QEMU executed, no shared artifacts modified.

blockers: Official QEMU TCG plugin API has no generic per-vCPU after-retirement callback.
Stock single-thread RR + plugin cannot force per-vCPU token scheduling; no public vCPU yield API.
MTTCG token path is feasible only with significant plugin/coordinator rework and cannot coexist with -icount.
Multi-core checkpoint sidecars and v2 manifest are designed but not implemented.
Shared-memory model/linearization and litmus outcome set are not frozen.
known_limits: No claim that multi-core RTL is implemented.
No claim that QEMU multi-vCPU per-core retirement is supported.
No claim that Linux SMP or full ARM memory model is verified.
Two-core sequence is canonical/normative, not an executed end-to-end result.
